title: Continuing Success
description: THE CONTINUING SUCCESS of STAR WARS led to the demand for fresh poster art. One concept that was later adapted by different artists is Luke and Leia swinging on a rope, gun blazing, to make their escape from stormtroopers aboard the Death Star. This concept art is by Dan Goozee with design work by Tony Seimger and Associates. Its army of stormtroopers on the bottom seems reminiscent of posters for biblical epics.
